company.heroTitle: Enterprise-grade security shouldn't cost a fortune.

company.missionBody: Legacy SIEM locked detection into proprietary formats, volume-based pricing and months-long deployments. We built Sigmaward on an open foundation and the Sigma standard to give the security team back control: detection you understand, data that stays yours and a price you can predict.
